subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Sentiment Analysis
description: Learn Sentiment Analysis in one minute.

hook.text: Platforms don't just read your posts. They analyze the emotions behind every word you write.

buildup.text: Sentiment analysis uses AI to classify text as happy, sad, angry, or anxious based on word patterns.

discovery.text: Facebook's internal research used sentiment analysis to identify teens feeling 'insecure' and 'worthless.'

twist.text: Advertisers can target users by emotional state. Feeling sad? Here's an ad for comfort food.

climax.text: Your words reveal your emotions. Platforms mine those emotions and sell access to your vulnerable moments.

punchline.text: Write how you feel. They sell your emotions.

quiz.question: How can sentiment analysis be misused by platforms?
options: Targeting ads based on users' emotional vulnerability
Automatically translating posts to other languages
